headline: Mitsotakis: Heating allowance up to €1,560 for 1.2 million households – Three bids for hydrocarbon exploration | News
summary: Greek Prime Minister Mitsotakis said the heating allowance is rising 30% to up to €1,560 for 1.2 million households. He also cited three bids for hydrocarbon exploration and developments in the energy sector.
why: Energy subsidies shape household spending and inflation, while hydrocarbon exploration bids affect long-term energy supply investment in the country.
